notes.title: Patch notes 3.22.24
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Friens![/h1]

Small but important changes coming in, Nothing super game changing, but important none the less:

tldr;
[list]
[*] Eyes added to Thumbnails when they've been at least partially seen.
[*] Loosened restricting's for the ending variations. 
[*] Swapped one of the Extra videos for a deeper look at post release.
[*] Small spelling & Punctuation errors
[/list]

[h2]Deeper Look[/h2]
[h3]Eyes on Thumbnails[/h3]
It was requested pre-release, but was a pain to implement on my end but after watching a stream and seeing other feedback, I've bit the bullet and figured out how to implement them. Now if you watch part of a video, you'll see the eye-con (ha) on the thumbnail in addition to the larger video. 


[h3]Loosened restrictions on Endings[/h3]
Initially the base number was supposed to be an out if you just had enough and wanted to be "done". That was fine and all, but the few other combinations turned out to be harder from what I expected to unlock.Making this feel as "logical" and "real" as I could was important to me, and it became clear that players were piecing the ends together better than the original videos I felt. Players know best, so i've loosened them a bit and you should see all of the options as long as you the player can at least piece together the plot points. 


[h3]Extra videos changed out[/h3]
Swapped out one of the middle extra videos for one I had wanted to record post release. Not really important to you, but this one was for me.


[h3]Spelling and Punctuation[/h3]
IDK if you need deeper insight here. I see mistake - I fix mistake.



[h1]Thanks Friens![/h1]
- Sam "Soavdannom"
